MacroAnnotations.0.Value: Adjusts the balance between the compressed and the uncompressed signals.

MacroAnnotations.1.Value: Adjusts the balance between the processed and the unprocessed signals. The processing chain consists of Pedal, Redux, Erosion, Drum Buss and Channel EQ.

MacroAnnotations.2.Value: This adjusts the balance between the input signal (dry) and the processed signal (wet).

MacroAnnotations.3.Value: This adjusts the time required for the Diffusion Network's tail to drop to 1/1000th (-60 dB) of its initial amplitude.

MacroAnnotations.4.Value: The amount of time it takes to reach peak volume after a note is triggered.

MacroAnnotations.5.Value: The amount of time it takes to fade to silence. When in Trigger mode, the fade begins this amount before the end of the region.

MacroAnnotations.6.Value: Global transpose amount, displayed in semitones. Note: Pitch control has no effect if the Slices are warped with Re-Pitch mode.

MacroAnnotations.7.Value: Boosts or attenuates the incoming level before limiting is applied.
